projects.title: HR Plus
projects.description: A powerful HR Management mobile system designed for internal company use, where employees join via invitation or QR code. It provides a complete employee profile including attendance, work status, leave balance, documents, contracts, salary details, and performance tracking. The system supports multi-role access (Employee, Manager, HR, Admin) with dynamic permissions and workflows. It also includes smart request handling with multi-step approval chains and a company-wide calendar for events and activities.
projects.problem: Companies struggle with fragmented HR processes, manual approvals, and lack of real-time visibility into employee data, attendance, and requests.
projects.solution: A centralized HR mobile system that automates attendance tracking, employee management, approvals, and HR workflows with role-based access and structured request pipelines.

projects.title: Saudi Extreme Calendar
projects.description: A Saudi-based events discovery mobile app built with Flutter that helps users explore and attend exciting activities across the Kingdom. It aggregates events like camping, safaris, concerts, beaches, sports, horse riding, entertainment, and amusement parks with real-time discovery through map search, filters, and a monthly calendar. Users can browse featured events, save favorites, receive notifications, and share events easily for a seamless social experience.
projects.problem: Users in Saudi Arabia struggle to discover relevant local events due to fragmented platforms, lack of centralized listings, and limited filtering or location-based discovery.
projects.solution: A unified events platform that organizes all activities in one place with smart filtering, map-based search, calendar view, and personalized recommendations.
projects.impact: Improves event discovery, boosts participation in local activities, enhances user engagement, and connects people more easily with entertainment across the Kingdom.
features: Notifications for New Events and Updates

projects.title: Qura'n Kareem
projects.description: Qura’n Kareem is a beautifully crafted Flutter mobile application designed to provide an immersive and interactive Holy Qur’an experience. It allows users to read, listen, and memorize the Qur’an with ease, featuring verse-by-verse audio recitation with selectable reciters. Users can navigate through chapters, search for specific verses, set bookmarks, and play selected passages or the entire Qur’an continuously for seamless listening and memorization support.
projects.problem: Many Qur’an apps lack smooth navigation, flexible audio control, and effective memorization tools in a single unified experience.
projects.solution: An all-in-one Qur’an platform that combines reading, high-quality audio recitation, smart navigation, and memorization features with personalized user control.
projects.impact: Enhances accessibility to the Qur’an, supports memorization and learning, and provides a calm, intuitive, and spiritually focused user experience.
features: Verse-by-verse Audio Playback with Selectable Reciters
Search and Navigation By Verse or Surah

projects.title: Itikaf
projects.description: A comprehensive mobile platform that streamlines the Itikaf experience at the Grand Mosque, covering registration, place assignment, in-stay services, smart gate access, and real-time support — built for pilgrims, staff, and administrators.
projects.problem: Managing Itikaf registration, place allocation, and on-ground services manually leads to overcrowding, lack of transparency, and poor pilgrim experience inside the Haram.
projects.solution: A unified app that automates Itikaf booking with eligibility screening, assigns locations dynamically based on capacity, provides GPS-guided navigation inside the Haram, and connects pilgrims to support services in real time.
projects.impact: Transforms the Itikaf experience through digital efficiency — reducing manual workload for staff, eliminating capacity conflicts, and giving pilgrims clarity and peace of mind from registration to check-out.
features: Capacity-based Location Assignment + Interactive Haram Map
In-stay Service Requests with Live Status Tracking
QR / NFC Smart Gate Check-in & Check-out
Multi-language (AR, EN, UR, ID, FR) & Dark Mode
Employee & Admin Panel with KPI Dashboard
